LanguageData.USAC_HeavyMiningRig.label: assault mining rig
LanguageData.USAC_HeavyMiningRig.description: A heavy vertical excavation platform delivered by orbital drop. An internal nuclear battery powers it, and vertical take-off and landing let it redeploy freely or return to orbit on its own.\n\nIt mines by pumping pressurized shallow groundwater into deep veins to fracture them, then drawing up the ore-laden slurry - highly automated, and thorough enough that infestations never take hold. Screening that slurry, however, discharges enormous volumes of wastewater laced with heavy metals and radioactive material, and the surrounding land pays for it.
